title: Random Entityes
description: Mobs never founded before in minecraft.you can make your game more dangerous with this new mobs!
body:
For the moment,this mod add two unique mobs.
# Mobs
-  The Smiler![The Smiler](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80e9a24e2b30cb948eafbf7873fa6b924b7dfdb1.png)
This fast mob is found in the taigas,if it see you,it will run foward to kill you.With his speed you are not escaping.Stats:Health:250.DamagePoints:35.(THIS MOB CAN GET A FULL REWORK IN THE NEXT UPDATE)
-  Still Life![The Still Life](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc20adc8051b15399d65417a714b43bab4ce998c.png)
This strange and strong anomaly is found in dark forests watching for a player or illager to kill.Stats:Health:150.DamagePoints:32.(THIS MOB CAN GET SOME CHANGES NEXT UPDATE)
- Next updates stuff:Mobs changes or rework, a backroom-like dimension for the Smiler and Still Life,Smiler FULL model, spawn and behavior rework,NEW mobs
